name: Desk reset
description: A quick break for anyone who sits a lot. Starts on the chair for the neck and spine, then stands to open the chest, hips and legs.

items.cue: Slide the chin straight back, eyes stay level.
Ear toward shoulder, opposite shoulder stays down.
Round and arch with your breath.
Sit tall, twist to each side in turn.
Bend side to side, hips stay planted.
Squeeze the shoulder blades and open the chest.
Elbows at shoulder height, lean through gently.
Tuck the pelvis and squeeze the back glute.
Knees together, hips pushed slightly forward.
Soft knees, let the head and arms hang.
